question.problem:
Find all real eigenvalues of the matrix
$A=[\begin{aligned}2 & 0 \\ -4 & 7\end{aligned}].$
question.worked_solution:
Let's start by writing the matrix $A-\lambda I:$
﻿﻿﻿

$$
A-\lambda I=[\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 0 \\ -4 & 7-\lambda \end{aligned}]
$$

Now, let's find and solve the characteristic equation $det(A-\lambda I)=0:$

$$
\begin{aligned}det(A-\lambda I) & =0 \\ |\begin{aligned}2-\lambda  & 0 \\ -4 & 7-\lambda \end{aligned}| & =0 \\ (2-\lambda )(7-\lambda )-0\cdot (-4) & =0 \\ (\lambda -2)(\lambda -7) & =0\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, the eigenvalues are $\lambda =2$ and $\lambda =7.$

**Note:** The eigenvalues of a triangular (or diagonal) matrix are the entries on the main diagonal.
